title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Add Agents and Skills from the Plus menu
description: Users will be able to insert Agents and Skills in prompts for specialized tasks. They can add them from the Agents and Skills tab after selecting 'Add work content' from the plus (+) menu. Users can also access Agents and Skills by typing / and @ in their prompt.
